units.source_text: “花瓣也会四下飘落吧……”太吉郎说，

en.t: The petals will probably scatter and fall all around too... Taikichiro said,

units.source_text: “只是郁金香的花太多了，我有点厌烦。

en.t: It is just that there are too many tulips, and I am a little tired of them.

units.source_text: 色彩过分鲜艳，反而会令人感到索然无味……

en.t: When the colors are too vivid, they can instead make one feel bored...
Perhaps it is because I am getting old.
